messages:
Ravi CSM: Heads-up — RetailCo renewal in 26 days, onboarding stopped after week 1. Usage flat, key admin left; looks like a classic stalled-onboard churn risk. Proposing a 10-day rapid rescue/playbook: triage, micro-enable, milestone credit. Thoughts?
Dana Enablement: +1. Need ARR and any blocked flows. If we make it a checklist with owner per step I can run it.
Ravi CSM: ARR $60k. Primary blocker: bulk CSV import fails intermittently. Marco, any logs?
Marco Support: Saw failures with large payloads and timeouts on 2026-03-12. Error: ```HTTP 504: import_timeout id=zzz-987```. I've captured the request IDs.
Lena Eng: If it’s timeouts we can add a retry-and-chunk strategy on our side quickly. I can ship a small handler to chunk >5MB imports. Need deploy window.
Ivy Research: From past saves, fastest wins are (1) guided import success in session, (2) one scripted report that shows ROI, (3) a short-term incentive. Suggest a 10-day plan with Day 4 pick-up metric.
Ravi CSM: Proposed rescue plan: Day 0 triage+patch, Day 1 guided import (30m), Day 3 template + report walkthrough, Day 7 milestone check. Offer a conditional 30-day credit cap $3k if Day 3 import & report are completed.
Dana Enablement: I can write the kickoff email + calendar invites and run the Day 1 guided import. Will use a step-by-step import script and a pre-made report template.
Marco Support: Patch branch opened to chunk large imports. Tagging @Deploy Bot for canary.
Deploy Bot: Canary scheduled: staging -> prod in 35m. Sending oncall alert.
Lena Eng: Will monitor and add metrics for import success rate; will roll back if error rate spikes.
acct-finance: Please include a short justification and expected upside for the credit; finance needs a final outcome note to release funds.
Ravi CSM: Noted — will document outcome. If patch deploys cleanly we'll schedule the guided import for Day 1.
Ivy Research: Add quick wins to the kickoff: (A) first report export, (B) simple rerank demo, (C) search sample. Make benefits explicit in customer comms.
Dana Enablement: Draft kickoff (please edit):
"Hi RetailCo — we have a 10-day plan to get you to a repeatable import + report. Day 1 we'll join for a 30m guided import. If we hit Day 3 milestones we'll apply a 30-day $3k credit. Can you confirm availability for a 30m tomorrow?"
Ravi CSM: Sending now. Internal action items: enablement invites (Dana), patch deploy & monitoring (Lena/Marco), credit hold prep (acct-finance).
Marco Support: Canary looks good after 20m; imports retried successfully in staging. Ready for prod.
Lena Eng: Prod deploy complete. Set alert for 72h import error spike.
Ravi CSM: Kicked off customer session — import succeeded during guided call. Scheduling Day 3 review. Will capture outcomes for finance. If this pattern helps, we should capture the checklist as a mini playbook for similar accounts.
